# brig start

Start a VM and connect its OpenShell gateway

## Synopsis

```text
brig start [NAME]
```

## Description

Start a VM, or reconnect a running one: register its OpenShell gateway with
the host's openshell CLI and apply its OpenShell config directories.

A gateway that does not answer and a failed sync only warn, so that the VM
is up for you to look into them. With --wait, they fail the command, with
exit status 5 and 6 (see brig --help), which scripts that go on to use the
gateway want.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--wait` | fail unless the gateway answers and the OpenShell config directories sync |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
